products.title: Electric Halloween
products.body_html:
Electric Halloween is a blue jelly nail lacquer with pink to orange to gold shifting iridiescent shimmer and green to turquoise to blue shifting iridescent flakes. 


Swatchers

Swatches coming soon!

About

Each bottle contains 12.0 ml of product.  Swatches generally display 2 coats of product with a top coat.

Alchemy Lacquers are all hand blended, in a 5-free base (unless otherwise indicated). This means that the lacquers does not contain formaldehyde, camphor, formaldehyde resins, DBP, or toluene. Each bottle contains two stainless steel agitator beads and a paddle brush.

All Alchemy Lacquers are made in small batches, therefore, there might be slight differences between bottles. We recommend that when your bottle arrives, that you give it a good shake and roll as the contents may settle over time. We try and take the most accurate color pictures possible, but sometimes monitors display differently.

Ingredients

Contains: Butyl Acetate, Ethyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Acetyl Tributyl Citrat

products.title: Glow in the Dark Mini Collection (Limited Edition)
products.body_html:
The Glow in the Dark Mini Collection s ia a 7-piece collection of mini (5ml) glow-in-the-dark nail lacquers. Please note that you are not buying full-sized bottles. This mini collection will only be available until October 31, 2026. 

- These nail lacquers are meant to be toppers and will not provide full coverage.Each bottle comes with a paddle brush, similiar to the brushes in our normal sized bottles.
-The glow of the color in the set are red, orange, yellow-green, aqua, blue, pink and white. Not all shades will glow with the same intensity and duration. Glow colors might be slightly different due to photography. 
- The longer your nails are charged the longer the glow time will be. 
- Glow time and brightness will vary between shades.
- Each shade can be charged with sun light, lamp light (depends on type of light bulb) and uv light, with uv light providing the longest and brightest glow and charge.
- Nail lacquers will dry down with a gritty texture and need top coat.
- We recommend using our anti-UV blocking top coat, Solar Shine as that has a limited amount of UV blocking ingredients.

products.body_html:
Solar Shine is a quick dry top coat that is 4-free. It can be used as a normal top coat, however we highly recommend this top coat when using solar nail lacquers. This top coat lacks the UV absorber Etocrylene and has a minimimal amount of Benzophenone-1 (also a UV Absorber) as these ingredients can diminish the transition effects of solar nail lacquers. 

Please note that this top coat has toulene in it.

Apply one coat to each nail after applying desired color.

products.title: Restorative Elixir
products.body_html:
Restorative Elixir, an additive used to thin nail polish.  To prevent evaporation of Restorative Elixir store with regular cap when not in use. 

Directions

To thin nail polish, dispense 2-3 drops of Restorative Elixir utilizing the twist cap. Close and secure nail polish bottle cap and shake vigorously, then check for consistency. Repeat process until desired consistency is reached. Not that glitter nail polishes tend to have a thicker consistency and adding too much Restorative Elixir will decrease the suspension abilities of the nail polish.

Ingredients

Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate.

products.body_html:
The magnet stand comes with one small magnet.

For clarity, the magnet is NOT attached to the stand and can be repositioned or even removed. Not all magnetic polishes are created the same and some magnetic polishes might need a stronger magnet than the one that is included in order to get a crisper magnetic line.

Please note that this stand is made out of a soft metal and the neck can be bent upwards or downwards. As a result, it will sometimes bend during shipping. It can be easily bent back into shape, but should it arrive in irreparable damage, please reach out before leaving a review.
